name: complete-dove-refactor
title: Complete Dove refactor after compatibility parity
description: Finish the remaining long-horizon Dove transition after the five-surface read-only compatibility layer is stable.
creator: tianyunlinger02

subtasks.title: Freeze the completed five-surface Dove compatibility baseline
subtasks.notes: Core/MCP/CLI/adapters/docs/tests now cover read-only orchestrate, mission, board, audit, and return surfaces. npm run check, pack dry-run, and CLI smoke passed.

subtasks.title: Decide package and command rename strategy
subtasks.notes: Selected and implemented the safe staged dual-name strategy: Dove is the primary product model, while paper-factory, paper.* commands, and .paper remain compatibility-authoritative until an explicit breaking rename is approved. Workspace kernel identity, Dove query output, package description, docs, and tests now reflect this.

subtasks.title: Design and implement .paper to .dove durable-root migration
subtasks.notes: Implemented the safe manifest-only durable-root migration strategy. .paper remains the only authoritative root; .paper/workspace/dove-root-manifest.json records .dove as the planned future target, the no-dual-root invariant, and blocked authoritative .dove artifacts. Workspace bootstrap creates and normalizes the manifest without creating .dove; Dove read-only queries expose the manifest without repairing malformed input; doctor rejects possible dual-authoritative .dove workspace state. Targeted tests, npm run commands:validate, npm run mcp:validate, npm run check, and npm run pack:dry-run passed.

subtasks.title: Add governed mutating Dove lifecycle surfaces
subtasks.notes: Implemented the minimal governed Dove write surface: dove.launch / launchDoveMission / launch_dove_mission / paper-factory dove-launch / dove launch. It materializes accepted guidance into the authoritative Dove mission-packet store backed by .paper/task-packets through the existing guarded bridge, requires sourceType/sourceId/executeBy/reviewAfter, carries Dove mission metadata, refuses possible authoritative .dove state, does not execute autonomy, and is exposed across OpenCode, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and shared agent adapters. commands:validate, mcp:validate, targeted integration/governance tests, npm run check, and npm run pack:dry-run passed.

subtasks.title: Unify internal mission terminology without weakening paper-specific workflows
subtasks.notes: Completed a safe additive terminology slice: Dove-facing outputs expose missionPacketId, missionPacketPath, missionPacketContextPath, missionPacketStorePath, and mission-packet source/compatibility metadata while preserving legacy packetId, packetPath, and .paper/task-packets backing compatibility. MCP and CLI accept missionPacketId aliases for board/launch flows; Dove adapters and docs now describe mission packets backed by .paper/task-packets. Paper-specific task-packet/materialize terminology remains intact on paper-compatible surfaces.

subtasks.title: Validate final Dove release boundary
subtasks.notes: Final validation passed on 2026-05-05: npm run commands:validate, npm run mcp:validate, targeted Dove/MCP/governance tests, npm run check with 161 passing tests, and npm run pack:dry-run with a 198-file package dry run. The completed refactor preserves staged dual-name compatibility: paper-factory/.paper remain authoritative, Dove is the product model, and breaking npm rename or authoritative .dove migration still require explicit future approval.

notes: Final Dove refactor is complete under the approved staged dual-name and manifest-only durable-root strategy. Dove is the primary product model; paper-factory, paper.* commands, and .paper remain compatibility-authoritative. The compatibility baseline, staged identity, manifest-only durable-root migration, governed launch write surface, mission-packet terminology aliases, and final validation are complete. Breaking npm rename and authoritative .dove migration remain explicit future non-goals until approved.
